title: DecisionRecord (archive actionability gate)
$comment: Structural residue of the effect.* rules (P0-5). The artifact that makes archived data actionable (effect.archive.decision-record): it joins an ObservationRecord to the EvidenceViewID under which the decision was made. A RELEASE decision additionally references the ReleaseAuthorization; DENY / DENY_EXPIRED record the closed outcome without fabricating an evidence verdict (effect.expiry.deny-expired). $defs are inlined (no cross-file $ref).

evidenceViewId.$comment: evidence.manifest.identity: the exact view the decision was derived from.

decision.$comment: The policy outcome, separate from the evidence verdict (claims.policy.profile-derived).

releaseAuthorizationId.$comment: Present exactly when decision is RELEASE (release-authorization.json).
